target.statement: MORE(CNN) achieves B3 F1 = 58.4 on the FewRel test set (16 relations, 1600 instances)
target.dataset: FewRel (64 train relations, 16 test relations with 1600 instances)

compute.basis: CNN encoder training on ~64 relations with RLL + VAT plus K-Means clustering is CPU-feasible, but the repo must be adapted to the paper's FewRel split and the exact F1 depends on clustering hyperparameters, so a clean re-run takes a few hours.

blockers: Repo may not include the exact FewRel split (64/16 relations) or the K-Means clustering script used for the reported F1
No pretrained checkpoints or configs for the CNN variant are guaranteed to be released
Reproducing the exact B3 F1 requires matching batch sampling, RLL hyperparameters (alpha_P=0.8, alpha_N=1.2, Tn=10) and clustering seed
title: MORE: A Metric Learning Based Framework for Open-domain Relation Extraction
